limitations: Short dynamic single-support pulses; no sustained single-wheel stand or forward walking verified.
Validated on flat ground at 0.098, 0.100, 0.102m nominal length, one CPU environment each. These are deterministic height variations, not random-seed trials.
Lift preset uses a spherical tread collision proxy and a sagittal observation adapter; original mesh control did not pass the three-pair protocol.
Approximate spring-damper five-bar closure remains; peak closure gap includes initialization.
A 60-second screen does not establish long-term station keeping or disturbance robustness.

keys.N: Request next side once when idle; press edges only, no queue while moving
